In this video we cover:
NSDL vs CDSL: Why Their Q2 Performance Was So Different
This story explains why NSDL and CDSL delivered very different results in FY26 Q2 even though both operate in India’s depository system. The video breaks down how depositories work and then compares their quarterly performance. NSDL reported strong growth driven by higher custody fees, institutional clients, and new fintech partnerships. Meanwhile, CDSL faced pressure from weaker trading volumes, lower transaction revenue, and challenges in its KYC subsidiary.
